    // The corner farthest along `direction`: each local axis independently takes
    // the sign of the direction's component on it.
    Support(b: Box3D, direction: Direction3D): Point3D
    {
        var f = b.Orientation.Basis3D;
        var d = direction.Vector;
        return b.Center
            + f.X * (d.Dot(f.X) >= 0.0 ? b.Size.Width * 0.5 : b.Size.Width * -0.5)
            + f.Y * (d.Dot(f.Y) >= 0.0 ? b.Size.Height * 0.5 : b.Size.Height * -0.5)
            + f.Z * (d.Dot(f.Z) >= 0.0 ? b.Size.Depth * 0.5 : b.Size.Depth * -0.5);
    }

    //==
    // # RoundedBox3D
    //
    // The Minkowski sum of a shrunken box with a ball of radius r. Writing the
    // shrunken (core) edge lengths p, q, s, Steiner's formula for a parallel body
    // gives the volume and area below exactly:
    //   V = pqs + r*2(pq+ps+qs) + pi*r^2*(p+q+s) + (4/3)pi*r^3
    //   A = 2(pq+ps+qs) + 2*pi*r*(p+q+s) + 4*pi*r^2
    // reading term by term as: the core box, the six face slabs, the twelve
    // quarter-cylinder edges (four per direction = one whole cylinder), and the
    // eight corner octants (= one whole ball).
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steiner_formula

    // CornerRadius clamped to the declaration's stated range: never negative, never
    // more than half the smallest extent. Every body below reads this.
    EffectiveCornerRadius(b: RoundedBox3D): Number
        => b.CornerRadius.Clamp(0.0,
            b.Box.Size.Width.Min(b.Box.Size.Height).Min(b.Box.Size.Depth) * 0.5);

    // The core box's full edge lengths (the original extents less twice the radius).
    CoreExtents(b: RoundedBox3D): Vector3D
    {
        var r = b.EffectiveCornerRadius;
        return (b.Box.Size.Width - 2.0 * r,
                b.Box.Size.Height - 2.0 * r,
                b.Box.Size.Depth - 2.0 * r);
    }

    // Steiner's parallel-body volume (see the section note).
    Volume(b: RoundedBox3D): Number
    {
        var r = b.EffectiveCornerRadius;
        var e = b.CoreExtents;
        var faces = e.X * e.Y + e.X * e.Z + e.Y * e.Z;
        return e.X * e.Y * e.Z
            + 2.0 * r * faces
            + Number.Pi * r.Square * (e.X + e.Y + e.Z)
            + 4.0 / 3.0 * Number.Pi * r.Cube;
    }

    // Steiner's parallel-body surface area (see the section note).
    SurfaceArea(b: RoundedBox3D): Number
    {
        var r = b.EffectiveCornerRadius;
        var e = b.CoreExtents;
        return 2.0 * (e.X * e.Y + e.X * e.Z + e.Y * e.Z)
            + 2.0 * Number.Pi * r * (e.X + e.Y + e.Z)
            + 4.0 * Number.Pi * r.Square;
    }

    // The box's centre; rounding is symmetric on every axis.
    Centroid(b: RoundedBox3D): Point3D
        => b.Box.Center;

    // The underlying box's bounds — the rounded solid touches all six faces, so
    // this is tight.
    Bounds(b: RoundedBox3D): Bounds3D
        => b.Box.Bounds;

    // The standard rounded-box inside test: fold the query into the first octant of
    // the box's own frame, subtract the core half-extents, and compare the
    // resulting distance to the corner radius. Boundary inclusive.
    // https://iquilezles.org/articles/distfunctions/
    Contains(b: RoundedBox3D, point: Point3D): Boolean
    {
        var r = b.EffectiveCornerRadius;
        var e = b.CoreExtents;
        var local = LocalOffset(b.Box.Center, b.Box.Orientation, point);
        var qx = local.X.Abs - e.X * 0.5;
        var qy = local.Y.Abs - e.Y * 0.5;
        var qz = local.Z.Abs - e.Z * 0.5;
        var outside = (qx.Max(0.0).Square + qy.Max(0.0).Square + qz.Max(0.0).Square).Sqrt;
        return outside + qx.Max(qy).Max(qz).Min(0.0) <= r;
    }

    // The support of a Minkowski sum is the sum of the supports: the core box's
    // extreme corner displaced by r along `direction`.
    Support(b: RoundedBox3D, direction: Direction3D): Point3D
    {
        var f = b.Box.Orientation.Basis3D;
        var e = b.CoreExtents;
        var d = direction.Vector;
        return b.Box.Center
            + f.X * (d.Dot(f.X) >= 0.0 ? e.X * 0.5 : e.X * -0.5)
            + f.Y * (d.Dot(f.Y) >= 0.0 ? e.Y * 0.5 : e.Y * -0.5)
            + f.Z * (d.Dot(f.Z) >= 0.0 ? e.Z * 0.5 : e.Z * -0.5)
            + d * b.EffectiveCornerRadius;
    }

    //==
    // # Capsule bodies
    //
    // Volume, surface area, bounds, centroid, containment, nearest-point and support
    // bodies for `Capsule3D` (declared in `spatial-primitives.types.plato`). The conventions
    // governing every body here are in the shared section above.

    //==
    // # Capsule3D
    //
    // The Minkowski sum of the segment [A, B] with a ball of radius r.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Capsule_(geometry)

    // The length of the capsule's spine.
    SpineLength(c: Capsule3D): Number
        => c.A.Between(c.B).Magnitude;

    // The cylindrical middle pi*r^2*L plus the two hemispherical ends, which
    // together make one whole ball (4/3)*pi*r^3.
    Volume(c: Capsule3D): Number
        => Number.Pi * c.Radius.Square * c.SpineLength + 4.0 / 3.0 * Number.Pi * c.Radius.Cube;

    // The cylindrical lateral surface 2*pi*r*L plus the two hemispheres, which
    // together make one whole sphere 4*pi*r^2. There are no flat caps.
    SurfaceArea(c: Capsule3D): Number
        => 2.0 * Number.Pi * c.Radius * c.SpineLength + 4.0 * Number.Pi * c.Radius.Square;

    // The spine's midpoint, by the capsule's mirror symmetries.
    Centroid(c: Capsule3D): Point3D
        => c.A.MidPoint(c.B);

    // The bounds of the two endpoints grown by the radius on every side.
    Bounds(c: Capsule3D): Bounds3D
        => (Point3D(c.A.X.Min(c.B.X) - c.Radius,
                    c.A.Y.Min(c.B.Y) - c.Radius,
                    c.A.Z.Min(c.B.Z) - c.Radius),
            Point3D(c.A.X.Max(c.B.X) + c.Radius,
                    c.A.Y.Max(c.B.Y) + c.Radius,
                    c.A.Z.Max(c.B.Z) + c.Radius));

    // True when the point is within Radius of the spine segment.
    Contains(c: Capsule3D, point: Point3D): Boolean
        => DistanceToSegment(c.A, c.B, point) <= c.Radius;

    // The query point when it lies in the capsule, otherwise the radial projection
    // onto the boundary from the nearest spine point.
    ClosestPoint(c: Capsule3D, point: Point3D): Point3D
    {
        var spine = ClosestPointOnSegment(c.A, c.B, point);
        var outward = spine.Between(point);
        return outward.MagnitudeSquared <= c.Radius.Square
            ? point
            : spine + outward.Normalize * c.Radius;
    }
